ns2:section.sectionText: Graduate Seminar in Evolution. Topic: Definitions and Evidence of Coevolution. Coevolutionary interactions are some of the most spectacular and best cited examples of evolution in action. Yet, theory and data are often difficult to reconcile, especially when arms races involve behavioral and cognitive adaptations. This seminar will survey and critique recent coevolutionary studies in high profile journals to evaluate their rigor, incrementalism, and innovation.
